0022600202.text: The Kings host the Miami Heat for their 10th game of the season, with Sacramento at 1-8 and in 15th place in the West, while Miami is 3-6 and ninth in the East. Sacramento has lost its last two games and is 0-4 at home, and it is without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), all listed as out. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and Miami won the most recent meeting 130-117 in Sacramento; they have not yet played each other this season.
